data.body: Landed via Gerrit change 1030 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/1030), merged as 074203c29 with LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved comments. Added the 'Responding to coaching moves' section to src/rebar/_guides/writing-a-passing-plan.md: top five moves in field-frequency order (specification by example, plan the verification w/ observable-proxy rule, riskiest-assumption test, state attestation evidence w/ [operator-attested] tag, propagate to children), each with a technique paragraph and before/after example, plus a one-line index of the ten remaining registered moves and a cross-link from the advisory section. New tests/unit/test_guides.py (5 tests) asserts the section, frequency order, examples, the tag, and exact MOVE_REGISTRY spellings; full unit suite 5855 passed / 19 skipped; make lint + make typecheck green.
